contexts.text: He had a concubine, and her name was Reumah () = the Gentiles who are in idolatrous worship and in good.
The handmaids given to the husband by the wife... were called concubines.

The reason their procreation of children by handmaids or concubines was at that time tolerated, was that thus were represented those who are outside the Church, also those who are in a lower degree within the Church. AC 8995:5.
To the sons of the concubines which Abraham had, Abraham gave presents () = the spiritual adopted by the Lord's Divine Human, that they had shares in the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom.
Hence it is that the spiritual are here called the sons of the concubines...

In order that both the celestial and the spiritual might be represented in their marriages, it was granted to have a concubine besides a wife; that concubine was given to the husband by the wife, and was then called his woman...

That these ancients had concubines besides a wife... was of permission, and for the sake of the representation, namely, of the Celestial Church by the wife, and of the Spiritual Church by the concubine. It was of permission, because they were such as to have no marriage love...
Reuben went, and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine () = the profanation of good by faith separated. AE 434:16.
This was a mere coupling like that of a concubine...
In order that the conjunctions and subordinations of such affections under one spiritual truth might be represented, it was permitted the Israelitish and Jewish nation to have a number of concubines.

[Swedenborg footnote 1.]. The reason the Israelitish nation was permitted... to join concubines to their wives, but not Christians, is that that nation was in externals without internals, but Christians can be in internals. References.

Solomon permitted and instituted the worship of many other nations, by which were represented the varieties of religion in the world. Similar was the signification of his wives who were seven hundred in number, and his concubines who numbered three hundred (); for a wife in the Word = the Church, and a concubine a religion.
The wife said, I am no longer a wife, but a concubine...
On concubinage. Chapter.
By concubinage is here meant the conjunction of a married man... with a woman...
There are two kinds of concubinage, which are very different from each other, one conjointly with a wife, and the other apart from a wife. General article.
Concubinage conjointly with a wife is unlawful for Christians, and detestable. General article. CL 465. CL 466.
In proportion as love towards a married partner is transcribed into love towards a concubine, it is rent, exhausted, and emptied.

A Christian cannot love a concubine and a wife equally, like a Mohammedan polygamist; but in proportion as he loves a concubine, or grows warm towards her, he does not love a wife, that is, he grows cold to her; and what is still more detestable, in the same proportion he at heart acknowledges the Lord as only a natural man, and as the son of Mary, and not at the same time as the Son of God; and in the same proportion also he undervalues religion. But it is to be well remembered that this takes place with those who add a concubine to a wife, and conjoin themselves actually with both; but not at all with those who, from causes lawful, just, and truly weighty, separate themselves... as to actual love, from the wife...
Concubinage apart from a wife, when it takes place from causes lawful, just, and truly weighty, is not unlawful. General article.
The lawful causes of this concubinage are the lawful causes of divorce, the wife being nevertheless retained at home. General article.
The just causes of this concubinage are the just causes of separation from the bed. General article.
The weighty causes of this concubinage are real and not real. General article.
They who from causes lawful, just, and really weighty are in this concubinage, can be at the same time in marriage love. General article.
This concubinage is only a veiling round of marriage love, because the love of concubinage is natural, and the love of marriage is spiritual...
So long as this concubinage is going on, actual conjunction with the wife is not allowable. General article.
The delight of having a concubine before marriage...
